'''Kylo Ren's TIE silencer''' was a prototype [[TIE/vn space superiority fighter]] used by [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] during the [[First Order]]'s [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] with the [[Resistance]]. Ren's use of the [[TIE series|TIE]] silencer allowed [[Sienar-Jaemus Fleet Systems]] to refine its onboard system from his detailed post-flight reports.

By flying the silencer against his enemies, Ren continued two traditions—the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] tradition that prototype [[starfighter]]s were tested by aces, with Ren following notable Imperial [[pilot]]s such as [[Vult Skerris]] and [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]]; and the tradition that as the [[Solo family|son]] of [[Han Solo]] and the [[Skywalker family|grandson]] of Anakin Skywalker, the former Ben Solo was a natural in the [[cockpit]].

==Description==
As with other [[TIE/vn space superiority fighter]]s, the [[TIE series|TIE]] silencer was noted for its speed and ferocity, as well as its [[laser cannon]]s and [[missile launcher]]s. The silencer was reminiscent of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[TIE/IN interceptor]], [[TIE Advanced x1]],<ref name="Databank" /> and [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter]]. It also featured customized flight controls specifically made for its test [[pilot]].<ref name="TLJ:ICS" />

==History==
{{Quote|Follow my lead.|Kylo Ren, to his wingmates during the Battle of Oetchi|<ref name="Episode VIII" />}}
[[File:Kylo_Ren_Pilots_Silencer.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The TIE silencer was a prototype starfighter that Kylo Ren field tested during the war between the First Order and the Resistance.]]
[[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]], the apprentice of [[Supreme Leader]] [[Snoke]],<ref name="Episode VIII" /> was an expert pilot like his [[Parent|father]] [[Han Solo]],<ref name="Databank" /> and [[Skywalker family|grandfather]] [[Anakin Skywalker]],<ref name="TLJ:ICS" /> respectively, before him.<ref name="Databank" /> Due to his piloting skills, he field tested a unique [[starfighter]] known as the TIE silencer—following in the tradition of Imperial ace pilots, such as [[Vult Skerris]] and [[Darth]] Vader, who flew prototype fighters. Developed by [[Sienar-Jaemus Fleet Systems]], the corporation utilized Ren's detailed post-flight reports to improve the [[Starship|vessel's]] onboard system.<ref name="TLJ:ICS" /> Ren utilized the silencer in his mission to [[First Order-Resistance War|destroy]] the [[Resistance]].<ref name="Databank" />

In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date Note">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] in [[34 ABY]]. [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] takes place immediately after the end of ''The Force Awakens''.</ref> Ren participated in the [[First Order]]'s [[Battle of Oetchi|attack]] on the [[Resistance navy|Resistance fleet]] shortly after the [[Battle of D'Qar|evacuation]] of [[D'Qar]]. Escorted by three [[TIE/sf space superiority fighter]]s, he used the TIE silencer to destroy the [[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|''Raddus'']]{{'s}} starboard [[hangar]], [[Death|killing]] several [[Resistance pilot]]s including [[Tallissan Lintra]] before moving to attack the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]]. However, he was unable to open fire on his target due to his mother, [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], being located the bridge at the [[time]] of the attack. Ren was then forced to pilot his starfighter back to the ''[[Supremacy]]'' at the advice of General [[Armitage Hux]], due to the Resistance [[fleet]] managing to outpace the First Order [[flagship]], thereby leaving him without support and at risk of being shot down.<ref name="Episode VIII" /> In the following [[Standard year|year]], Ren instead flew a [[Kylo Ren's TIE whisper|TIE whisper]].<ref name="EpIXVD">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Kylo Ren's TIE silencer was created and developed for [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']],<ref name="SW Show">{{StarWarsShow|tMTExpDs7WA|Kylo Ren's New Ship, The Last Jedi Cast at D23, & Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge!|sw_url=video/kylo-ren-s-new-ship-the-last-jedi-cast-at-d23-and-star-wars-galaxy-s-edge}}</ref> the eighth film in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' saga, which was released on [[December 15]], [[2017]].<ref name="The Last Jedi">{{SW|url=news/the-official-title-for-star-wars-episode-viii-revealed|text=The Official Title for ''Star Wars: Episode VIII'' Revealed}}</ref> The [[Starship|ship]] was officially revealed on ''[[The Star Wars Show]]'' on [[July 19]], 2017<ref name="SW Show date">{{StarWarsShow|tMTExpDs7WA|Kylo Ren's New Ship, The Last Jedi Cast at D23, & Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge!|sw_url=video/kylo-ren-s-new-ship-the-last-jedi-cast-at-d23-and-star-wars-galaxy-s-edge}}</ref> and prior to the film's release, Kylo Ren's TIE silencer was introduced to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]'' on [[November 9]], 2017.<ref name="SWGOH Events">{{WebCite|url=https://swgohevents.com/event/first-order-relentless-iii|text=The First Order Relentless|date=2017-11-09|archivedate=20200411142025}}</ref>

Although Kylo Ren's TIE silencer was originally planned by the [[Industrial Light & Magic]] VFX team to feature [[missile]] pods on its underside and shoot them off, VFX supervisor [[Mike Mullholland]] revealed that during the film's early development, director [[Rian Johnson]] received an early prototype of the TIE silencer's toy version by [[Hasbro]], so the FFX team were forced to redesign the fighter.<ref name="Toy Design">{{WebCite|url=https://io9.gizmodo.com/a-toy-design-actually-forced-a-change-to-star-wars-the-1823070091|text=A Toy Design Actually Forced a Change to Star Wars: The Last Jedi|author=Whitbrook, James|date=2018-02-16|quote=Initially, the plan was to have [[missile]]s on the underside, and shoot them off, and that was it. But halfway through production [[Rian Johnson|Rian]] got a toy, a prototype toy of the [[Ben Solo|Kylo]] fighter. And they had the missiles on the side wings! So we went and redesigned a bit of it [in the movie] so that we could open it up and pop them out. I've heard of the toys' influence in the past, but that was the first time for [[Mike Mullholland|me]].|archivedate=20200103153605}}</ref>

Kylo Ren's TIE silencer, shortened to TIE Silencer, was introduced as a playable ship in the 2015 mobile game Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes in 2017, which features characters and ships from both the canon and Legends continuities.<ref name="GoH">''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]''</ref>
